title: Altman takes OpenAI's memory squeeze to Samsung's boardroom
summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman met about 50 Samsung Group executives in Yongin, south of Seoul, on Saturday, with memory supply and AI infrastructure on the agenda alongside a wider session on how AI may reshape their industries. Samsung said the talks build on earlier cooperation to supply memory for OpenAI's Stargate build-out. Memory accounts for roughly a third of data-centre spending, and shortages across memory categories are pushing chip prices higher.
